units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 51:31">Targ. Jer. LI, 31</cite>.—Pl. <he>רְהִיטַיָּא</he>, <he>רְהִיטֵי</he>. Targ. II Esth. III, 13 ed. Lag.; (ib. 15 <he>רהטיא</he>); a. e., v. <cite ref="T00283"><he>רַהֲטוֹנָא</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b:9">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite> <he>שתין ר׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00715"><he>צַפְרָא</he></cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:2">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>רָהוֹטֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 78b:6">Sabb. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>רהיטי מוכסא</he> (Ar. <he>רהוטי</he>) the runners (police) of the toll collector (who ask persons they meet for their receipts).
